items.title: 李家超致贺香港特区选委会当选委员 冀秉持“爱国者治港”原则履职尽责
items.summary: 中新社香港11月22日电 香港特区行政长官李家超22日向2026年香港特区选举委员会(简称“选委会”)界别分组一般选举当选委员致贺。他期望所有选委会委员秉持“爱国者治港”原则履职尽责，为“一国两制”实践行稳致远贡献力量。
items.titleEn: Li Xiang, elected member of the Hong Kong Special District Election Commission, upholds the principles of the rule of Hong Kong
items.summaryEn: On November 22, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Administrator Li Keqiang delivered a letter to the Election Commission of Hong Kong Special District (HEC) for the year 2026. He expects all the members of the Election Commission to carry out their duties in accordance with the principle of Patriotic Governance of Hong Kong and to make a lasting contribution to the practice of the two-party system of Hong Kong.

items.title: 香港特区选委会界别分组一般选举结果揭晓 全部选委顺利产生
items.summary: 中新社香港11月22日电 (记者 刘玥晴)2026年香港特区选举委员会(简称“选委会”)界别分组一般选举结果22日晚揭晓。根据选举事务处公布的结果，856名候选人竞逐的31个界别分组中723席选委全部顺利产生。
items.titleEn: The results of the Hong Kong Special Election Commission's general election reveal that all elections were conducted smoothly.
items.summaryEn: The results of the general elections of the Hong Kong Special Election Commission (HEC) for the year 2026 were released late on 22 November. According to the results published by the Electoral Affairs Office, 723 seats in 31 sub-groups of 856 candidates contested were all successfully won.

items.title: 2026中国壁球公开赛落幕 埃及和马来西亚选手分获男、女单打冠军

items.summaryEn: The final of the 2026 Chinese Open was held in Shanghai on the evening of November 22. The Egyptian Mustafa Asar, the Malaysian Subramaniam Sevasangari, won the men's and women's singles titles.

items.title: 青海德令哈5.6级地震经三轮排查无人员伤亡
items.summary: 中新网西宁11月22日电 (记者 潘雨洁)22日晚间，记者从青海省地震局获悉，目前青海省海西州德令哈市已开展三轮拉网式滚动排查，经排查，全市无人员伤亡、无房屋倒塌、无重大财产损失及重大安全险情。

The Chinese team won 2 gold, 3 silver and 2 bronze, placing second in the medal table, behind the traditional Dutch team.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
